gloss: fighting on alone; a lone struggle

definitions.gloss: fighting on alone; struggling without support
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) for carrying on a hard fight by oneself, with no reinforcements and no help from those around you. Used of work, sport, and campaigns far more often than of actual battle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦くれ→くれる：00724_kureru⟧ず、{孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧だ。
examples.english: Nobody helps out, so every day is a lone struggle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{数年間|すうねんかん}{孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: One legislator kept up a lone struggle for several years to get the new system passed.

notes:
From {孤軍|こぐん} (an isolated army) + ⟦{奮闘|ふんとう}→奮闘：07901_funtou⟧ (to struggle hard). The tone is sympathetic: it praises the effort while pointing out that the person should not have had to make it alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fight on alone
- {孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to keep up a lone struggle
- {孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: the sight of someone struggling alone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪戦苦闘|あくせんくとう}→悪戦苦闘：20178_akusenkutou⟧: a desperate struggle — stresses how hard the fight is, not the isolation
- ⟦{奮闘|ふんとう}→奮闘：07901_funtou⟧: to struggle hard — the plain word, with no sense of being alone
